issue.title: cli-directives, split: % directives, bare-# type marker, %t templates, and @@ cleanup
issue.description: Deliver phase cli-directives (bead bob-cli-ey.1) of the "Capture drawers and % directives" epic as a chain of coherent bob-cli changes, each small enough for one coding agent: delete `@@route+id`; add the `%` directive lexer with `%c`, `%n`, and `%l`; split clipboard parsing from reading; make a bare edge `#` an incomplete type marker; replace `@@template:`/`@@@` with `%t`; then add the `directive` completion context, `initial_selection`, and `grammar: 2`. The land agent closes bob-cli-ey.1.
